replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. First, standardize the data. Sort the eigenvectors by their eigenvalues in descending order and choose the top k eigenvectors. Project the data onto the new subspace formed by these eigenvectors.
